raj_sales: Quick check — AcmeHealth POC ready to sign order form but legal pushed back on DPA Appendix A (subprocessors + KMS). Can we take the KMS ask? :thinking:

devon_se: Technical: we can do customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for Dedicated/private. It requires a config window and PS to wire the key rotation + access controls. Rough ETA ~10 business days once PO + MSA signed.

emma_s: @miguel_legal tagging you — they added a clause asking for monthly HSM attestation and a contractual SLA on key custody. That's a hard ask. Thoughts?

miguel_legal: Read their redline. Monthly attestation + explicit HSM SLA is a no from us. Alternative we can offer: annual SOC2 + ad-hoc attestation under NDA and a bounded KMS integration commitment. Propose language below.

miguel_legal: ```
Proposed DPA/KMS paragraph:
"Redwood will support customer-managed key integrations with approved KMS providers. Redwood will implement the integration as a professional services engagement and maintain access controls consistent with industry standards. Redwood does not provide monthly HSM attestations; Redwood will provide access to audited reports (e.g., SOC 2) and reasonable evidence of implementation upon signed NDA and within mutually agreed timelines."
```

sophie_procure: Procurement notes: buyer will do Net45 PO, needs invoice to match PO number and 2 signers (Exec + Finance). They insist on DocuSign with signer certificate. Is DocuSign cert okay?

emma_s: DocuSign with certificate is fine. We can route envelope: exec -> finance -> countersign. @finance_bot confirm invoice routing and whether Net45 acceptable.

finance_bot: Confirmed: Net45 acceptable. Invoice to billing@redwood.com with PO#. We will attach invoice to customer account and mark terms Net45. For eSign routing send envelope to exec@acmehealth.com then finance@acmehealth.com.

raj_sales: OK — plan: 1) send Miguel's proposed language to buyer and ask them to drop monthly attestation, 2) confirm they'll accept BYOK + annual SOC2, 3) send orderform + PO instructions (billing@redwood.com) and eSign path.

devon_se: If buyer signs, tell them to flag Dedicated/private deployment in order form so we schedule the integration window. Blockers: HSM SLA, and custom attestation timeline.

miguel_legal: Quick follow-up: add this sentence to the redline so we don't promise attestations on short notice: "Requests for additional evidence beyond published audit reports will be responded to within 30-60 days and may require a separate agreement or reasonable fees."

raj_sales: I'll push that. cc @sophie_procure to capture PO/netterms. Sending to buyer now. :thumbsup:

emma_s: Thanks — will stand by for buyer reply. If they insist on monthly attestation escalate to me + Miguel.

sophie_procure: I'll prep the PO template and include the two signer emails. Will upload draft PO once buyer confirms payment terms.

raj_sales: Thread closed until buyer replies.
